description.name: Passkey / Security Key
description.tagline: Sign in with a fingerprint, face, device PIN or a hardware security key.
description.long:
Uses WebAuthn (FIDO2) as the second factor for clients and admins: Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android, password-manager passkeys and hardware keys such as YubiKey.

Phishing resistant, with nothing to type. Open source and verified entirely on your own server, with no third-party service.
